# pixiv Comic (pixivコミック) fixtures

`captured-work.json`, `series.html`, and `reader.html` contain a 2026-10-25 capture of work `9830`, 嘆きの亡霊は引退したい ～最弱ハンターによる最強パーティ育成術～, and episode `154853`. They preserve metadata, catalog order, availability, and all 21 page paths and dimensions. The reader retains the background-image containers used by the parser.

Scripts, advertising, account/session data, and chapter image bytes have been removed. Request salt and image keys are synthetic. Browser tests use generated 64×64 PNG images for reconstruction. The second navigation work and uncaptured episode manifests are synthetic.
